G.one: persistent typed evidence/experiment lineage with immutable identities, source spans, support/contradiction, separate research and engine lineage
G.zero: flat append-only notes with the same accessible content; no typed edges, graph gates, or lineage operations

C.one: exactly two independently generated mechanism-distinct designs; independent critic may explain defects; deterministic preregistered rule admits/revises/blocks and records rejected alternative
C.zero: one design; no tournament, alternative generation, or selection

F.one: at most three preregistered falsification/refinement rounds; stop after two consecutive improvements below the minimum threshold or budget exhaustion

cells.semantics: flat append-only notes with equal accessible content; one design, no tournament or alternative selection; one-shot execution and review, no revision
flat append-only notes with equal accessible content; one design, no tournament or alternative selection; up to three preregistered falsification/refinement rounds
flat append-only notes with equal accessible content; two independent mechanism-distinct designs + deterministic admission; one-shot execution and review, no revision
flat append-only notes with equal accessible content; two independent mechanism-distinct designs + deterministic admission; up to three preregistered falsification/refinement rounds
typed immutable evidence/experiment lineage; one design, no tournament or alternative selection; one-shot execution and review, no revision
typed immutable evidence/experiment lineage; one design, no tournament or alternative selection; up to three preregistered falsification/refinement rounds
typed immutable evidence/experiment lineage; two independent mechanism-distinct designs + deterministic admission; one-shot execution and review, no revision
typed immutable evidence/experiment lineage; two independent mechanism-distinct designs + deterministic admission; up to three preregistered falsification/refinement rounds

randomization: randomize and counterbalance the eight-cell order within each task; preserve the generated schedule before outcomes

G1: research and engine lineage are separate
G0: flat notes contain the same source content
typed edge and lineage operation counts equal zero
C1: deterministic admission emits one selection and one recorded rejected alternative
F1: every revision follows a preregistered falsifier

protocol_failure: any undeclared treatment difference or failed manipulation check invalidates the run for protocol-complete analysis while retaining it in intention-to-run reliability
claim_limit: best observed among the eight preregistered configurations under the evaluated task distribution and budget; never globally optimal or SOTA

requirements: candidate generators run in separate fresh contexts
candidate B cannot read candidate A transcript, files, or mechanism label
distinct sealed outer seeds and transcript digests
both candidates freeze before critic access
candidate_independence_check.failure: any cross-candidate read, identical transcript digest, or post-critic candidate mutation invalidates the C1 run

g0_content_equivalence_check.rule: G0 and G1 receive the same multiset of all treatment-accessible source text, task text, receipts, and prior decisions; only graph structure, typed edges, gates, and lineage operations differ
g0_content_equivalence_check.measurement: canonicalize accessible content records by media type and bytes, sort SHA-256 digests, and require identical multiset digests before each paired cell run
g0_content_equivalence_check.failure: missing, added, truncated, reordered-with-semantic-effect, or condition-specific accessible content is a protocol failure

fail_closed_loader_check.registry: exactly the eight runner_config_id -> runner_config_sha256 pairs in this manifest
before_run: reject unknown or duplicate config ID
recompute canonical config SHA-256 and require registry equality
assert loaded G/C/F flags equal the scheduled cell
assert fixed-surface digest equals every other cell
receipt: loader check result and exact failure reason
fail_closed_loader_check.failure: runner must exit before any model call if any identity or manipulation check fails

C_prior_work_boundary.testable_delta: C1 isolates two generators, freezes both candidates before criticism, then uses a deterministic predicate and preserves the rejected alternative

G_interoperability_boundary.internal: ARGO causal/admissibility graph with immutable typed evidence and separate research/engine lineage
G_interoperability_boundary.external: RO-Crate profile containing high-level entities plus a linked W3C PROV bundle
not_claimed: invention of provenance vocabularies or research packaging

evaluation_budget_boundary.fixed_rule: all cells have identical hard token/tool/time/cost maxima and hidden final scorer visibility
evaluation_budget_boundary.estimand: mean ITT over scheduled nested seeds; no best-of-k
evaluation_budget_boundary.non_transfer: RE-Bench task or human scores do not establish ARGO efficacy

randomness_identity.environment_seed: shared schedule value propagated to all controllable task/library RNGs
randomness_identity.rollout_id: unique API call identity nested within task-cell
randomness_identity.pairing: cell means compared within task; no claim of common model random numbers
randomness_identity.legacy_status: T3/T1 seed labels do not satisfy this contract
